connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-for-ynab. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the walensis-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: YNAB_ACCESS_TOKEN

env.name: YNAB_ALLOW_WRITES
env.description: Set to 1 to enable write tools (off = read-only)
